name: taknai.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But images must have alternative text.
lesson: Describe what each image shows in its alt attribute, and use alt="" on purely decorative ones.
summary: taknai.com scores 73 out of 100 (C). 5 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 36 pass. Fix first: 75 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 75 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /submit/, /category/%e0%b8%97%e0%b8%b2%e0%b8%87%e0%b8%9a%e0%b9%89%e0%b8%b2%e0%b8%99/, /category/1pic/ and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Images must have alternative text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 60 elements on /, /submit/, /category/%e0%b8%97%e0%b8%b2%e0%b8%87%e0%b8%9a%e0%b9%89%e0%b8%b2%e0%b8%99/, for example a[href="https://taknai.com/19024/"] > .me-1.rounded and .p-2[href="https://taknai.com/23714/"][target="_self"] >…
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 9 elements on /, /submit/, /category/%e0%b8%97%e0%b8%b2%e0%b8%87%e0%b8%9a%e0%b9%89%e0%b8%b2%e0%b8%99/, for example #menu-item-12288 > a[href$="submit/"] and #menu-item-12333 > a. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /category/%e0%b8%97%e0%b8%b2%e0%b8%87%e0%b8%9a%e0%b9%89%e0%b8%b2%e0%b8%99/, for example .dropdown-toggle. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: 33 images are not served as WebP or AVIF
fix.evidence: 23961-0-1792779194090.png on / (PNG, 2086 KB), 1000000111.jpg on / (JPEG, 626 KB), 33713.jpg on / (JPEG, 518 KB), C80CAC7D-C800-410B-81F5-8BE28A8623AA.jp… on / (JPEG, 213 KB) and 29 more. WebP is about 30% smaller at the same quality, so about 1549 KB could…
fix.fix: Serve WebP or AVIF through the CDN or image service, or with <picture> and a JPEG or PNG fallback.
